scope: Individual visual review of 39 current full PNG images, one image at a time. Synthetic production Compose states, not a physical device or live VPN/call validation. OS status bar styling in isolated fixtures is outside this content review. ru-geo-large is a duplicate normal-size capture, not independent enlarged-font coverage.
